notes.title: Patch Notes - october 27 2024 Halloween
notes.notes:
Halloween Special Update

Added new anomalies and a new environment that you can enable or disable for each night. During the event, it will be enabled by default.

- Fixed a small shadow issue.

An important announcement will be made in December, stay tuned for more updates!

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Release Announcement: Smile, You're Being Filmed
notes.notes:
🎮 We Have Big News! 🎮

We are thrilled to announce that Smile, You're Being Filmed is now available on Steam! Dive into an exciting adventure where every corner of the house hides mysteries and dangers.

🌟 About the Game 🌟
In Smile, You're Being Filmed, you are hired to watch over a typical American house for three nights, but not everything goes as planned. Your mission is to repair anomalies while avoiding an increasingly aggressive assailant. Every detail matters for your survival in this game that blends horror and strategy.

📅 Availability 📅
Smile, You're Being Filmed is available now on Steam. Download it today and get ready for an intense and terrifying gaming experience.

We want to thank everyone who supported our project. Your enthusiasm and feedback have been crucial for us. We hope you find as much joy in playing Smile, You're Being Filmed as we did in developing it.

Stay tuned for more updates and additional content!

Thank you and happy gaming! 🎉

notes.title: Release of the Demo/Playtest
notes.notes:
-  Explore Horror With Our Steam Demo!

Immerse yourself in a world of horror and mystery with the long-awaited demo of "Smile, You're Being Filmed"! Available now on Steam, this demo gives you a thrilling preview of what awaits you in our gripping horror game.

-  A Dark Night

In this demo you will have the opportunity to experience Night 1, which also serves as a tutorial to familiarize yourself with the basic mechanics of the game. Learn to recognize and repair the anomalies that haunt every corner of the house, while exploring the mysteries that surround you.

-  Mysteries to Discover

Immerse yourself in an immersive atmosphere where every dark corner hides mysteries to discover. Explore the seemingly ordinary house, but beware of the grisly surprises that may await you in the darkness.

-  Join us in Horror

Download the "Smile, You're Being Filmed" demo on Steam now and enjoy a terrifying experience you won't soon forget. Are you ready to face your fears and discover the dark secrets that await you? Join us in horror and show us what you're made of!

  Join our community on Discord to chat with other players and stay up to date with the latest gaming news: https://discord.gg/SpS2j9huBp

  Support us by sharing your experience

Share your scariest moments and most astonishing discoveries with the community using the hashtag #SmileYoureBeingFilmed on social media
